============================================================================\n\n:root {\n  /* Primary Colors */\n  --primary-50: #eff6ff;\n  --primary-100: #dbeafe;\n  --primary-200: #bfdbfe;\n --success-50: #f0fdf4;\n  --success-100: #dcfce7;\n  --success-200: #bbf7d0;\n  --success-300: #86efac;\n  --success-400: #4ade80;\n  --success-500: #22c55e;\n  --success-600: #16a34a;\n --warning-300: #fcd34d;\n  --warning-400: #fbbf24;\n  --warning-500: #f59e0b;\n  --warning-600: #d97706;\n  --warning-700: #b45309;\n  --warning-800: #92400e;\n  --warning-900: #78350f;\n\n  /* Error       "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Whosonset Design System\n\n## Overview\nWhosonset uses a modern, sophisticated design system inspired by premium film industry brands like Nowness, A24, and Behance. The design emphasizes clean typography, subtle animations, and a refined color palette.\n\n## Color Palette\n\n### Primary Colors\n- **White**: &#96;#ffffff&#96; - Primary background\n- **Gray 50**: &#96;#f9fafb&#96; - Subtle background gradients\n- **Gray 100**: &#96;#f3f4f6&#96; - Light backgrounds and borders\n- **Gray 200**: &#96;#e5e7eb&#96; - Form borders and hover states\n- **Gray 300**: &#96;#d1d5db&#96; - Hover borders\n- **Gray 400**: &#96;#9ca3af&#96; - Focus states\n- **Gray 500**: &#96;#6b7280&#96; - Secondary text\n- **Gray 600**: &#96;#4b5563&#96; - Body text\n- **Gray 700**: &#96;#374151&#96; - Strong text\n- **Gray 800**: &#96;#1f2937&#96; - Headings\n- **Gray 900**: &#96;#111827&#96; - Primary headings and buttons\n\n### Status Colors\n- **Green**: &#96;bg-green-100 text-green-800&#96; - Available/Active\n- **Blue**: &#96;bg-blue-100 text-blue-800&#96; - Pre-production\n- **Purple**: &#96;bg-purple-100 text-purple-800&#96; - Post-production\n- **Yellow**: &#96;bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800&#96; - Development\n- **Orange**: &#96;bg-orange-100 text-orange-800&#96; - In progress\n- **Red**: &#96;bg-red-100 text-red-800&#96; - Cancelled/Unavailable\n\n## Typography\n\n### Font Weights\n- **Light (300)**: Primary font weight for headings and body text\n- **Medium (500)**: Used for labels and emphasis\n- **Regular (400)**: Fallback for system fonts\n\n### Font Sizes\n- **6xl**: &#96;text-6xl&#96; - Hero headings\n- **4xl**: &#96;text-4xl&#96; - Section headings\n- **3xl**: &#96;text-3xl&#96; - Page titles\n- **2xl**: &#96;text-2xl&#96; - Subsection headings\n- **xl**: &#96;text-xl&#96; - Card titles\n- **lg**: &#96;text-lg&#96; - Body text\n- **base**: &#96;text-base&#96; - Default text\n- **sm**: &#96;text-sm&#96; - Small text and labels\n- **xs**: &#96;text-xs&#96; - Micro text\n\n### Letter Spacing\n- **Tight**: &#96;tracking-tight&#96; - Hero headings\n- **Wide**: &#96;tracking-wide&#96; - Section headings\n- **Wider**: &#96;tracking-wider&#96; - Labels and buttons\n\n## Layout Patterns\n\n### Hero Sections\n&#96;&#96;&#96;jsx\n",

        "originalContents": "# Whosonset Design System\n\n## Overview\nWhosonset uses a modern, sophisticated design system inspired by premium film industry brands like Nowness, A24, and Behance. The design emphasizes clean typography, subtle animations, and a refined color palette.\n\n## Color Palette\n\n### Primary Colors\n- **White**: &#96;#ffffff&#96; - Primary background\n- **Gray 50**: &#96;#f9fafb&#96; - Subtle background gradients\n- **Gray 100**: &#96;#f3f4f6&#96; - Light backgrounds and borders\n- **Gray 200**: &#96;#e5e7eb&#96; - Form borders and hover states\n- **Gray 300**: &#96;#d1d5db&#96; - Hover borders\n- **Gray 400**: &#96;#9ca3af&#96; - Focus states\n- **Gray 500**: &#96;#6b7280&#96; - Secondary text\n- **Gray 600**: &#96;#4b5563&#96; - Body text\n- **Gray 700**: &#96;#374151&#96; - Strong text\n- **Gray 800**: &#96;#1f2937&#96; - Headings\n- **Gray 900**: &#96;#111827&#96; - Primary headings and buttons\n\n### Status Colors\n- **Green**: &#96;bg-green-100 text-green-800&#96; - Available/Active\n- **Blue**: &#96;bg-blue-100 text-blue-800&#96; - Pre-production\n- **Purple**: &#96;bg-purple-100 text-purple-800&#96; - Post-production\n- **Yellow**: &#96;bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800&#96; - Development\n- **Orange**: &#96;bg-orange-100 text-orange-800&#96; - In progress\n- **Red**: &#96;bg-red-100 text-red-800&#96; - Cancelled/Unavailable\n\n## Typography\n\n### Font Weights\n- **Light (300)**: Primary font weight for headings and body text\n- **Medium (500)**: Used for labels and emphasis\n- **Regular (400)**: Fallback for system fonts\n\n### Font Sizes\n- **6xl**: &#96;text-6xl&#96; - Hero headings\n- **4xl**: &#96;text-4xl&#96; - Section headings\n- **3xl**: &#96;text-3xl&#96; - Page titles\n- **2xl**: &#96;text-2xl&#96; - Subsection headings\n- **xl**: &#96;text-xl&#96; - Card titles\n- **lg**: &#96;text-lg&#96; - Body text\n- **base**: &#96;text-base&#96; - Default text\n- **sm**: &#96;text-sm&#96; - Small text and labels\n- **xs**: &#96;text-xs&#96; - Micro text\n\n### Letter Spacing\n- **Tight**: &#96;tracking-tight&#96; - Hero headings\n- **Wide**: &#96;tracking-wide&#96; - Section headings\n- **Wider**: &#96;tracking-wider&#96; - Labels and buttons\n\n## Layout Patterns\n\n### Hero Sections\n&#96;&#96;&#96;jsx\n",

        "contents": "/**\n * ENHANCED DESIGN SYSTEM\n * =====================\n * \n * Modern, professional design system with gradients, improved shadows,\n * and enhanced visual hierarchy\n */\n\n// ============================================================================\n// ENHANCED COLOR PALETTE\n// ============================================================================\n\n:root {\n  /* Enhanced Primary Colors with Gradients */\n  --primary-50: #eff6ff;\n  --primary-100: #dbeafe;\n  --primary-200: #bfdbfe;\n  --primary-300: #93c5fd;\n  --primary-400: #60a5fa;\n  --primary-500: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);\n  --gradient-secondary: linear-gradient(135deg, #f093fb 0%, #f5576c 100%);\n  --gradient-success: linear-gradient(135deg, #4facfe 0%, #00f2fe         "contents": "\n\nconst ProjectsPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const [projects, setProjects] = useState\u003cProject[]\u003e([]);\n  const [favorites, setFavorites] = useState\u003cFavoriteProject[]\u003e([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n  const [tab, setTab] = useState\u003c'all' | 'mine' | 'favorites'\u003e('all');\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const user = auth.currentUser;\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const fetchProjects = async () =\u003e {\n      setLoading(true);\n      setError(null);\n      try {\n        const q = query(collection(db, 'Projects'));\n        const snapshot = await getDocs(q);\n        const data = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() })) as Project[];\n        setProjects(data);\n      } catch (err: any) {\n        setError(t('projects.errorLoading'));\n      } finally {\n        setLoading(false);\n      }\n    };\n    \n    const loadFavorites = async () =\u003e {\n      if (user) {\n        try {\n          const userFavorites = await FavoritesService.getFavorites();\n          setFavorites(userFavorites);\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error('Error loading favorites:', error);\n          setFavorites([]); // Set empty array on error\n        }\n      } else {\n        setFavorites([]); // Clear favorites when no user\n      }\n    };\n\n    fetchProjects();\n    loadFavorites();\n  }, [t, user]);\n\n  const handleEdit = (projectId: string) =\u003e {\n    navigate(&#96;/edit-project/${projectId}&#96;);\n  };\n\n  const handleDelete = async (projectId: string) =\u003e {\n    if (!window.confirm(t('projects.confirmDelete'))) return;\n    try {\n      await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'Projects', projectId));\n      setProjects(projects =\u003e projects.filter(p =\u003e p.id !== projectId));\n    } catch (err) {\n      alert(t('projects.deleteFailed'));\n    }\n  };",

        "contents": "\n\nconst MyProjectsPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const [projects, setProjects] = useState\u003cProject[]\u003e([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const fetchProjects = async () =\u003e {\n      setLoading(true);\n      setError(null);\n      const user = auth.currentUser;\n      if (!user) {\n        setError(t('projects.mustBeLoggedIn'));\n        setLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n      try {\n        const q = query(collection(db, 'Projects'), where('owner_uid', '==', user.uid));\n        const snapshot = await getDocs(q);\n        const data = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() })) as Project[];\n        setProjects(data);\n      } catch (err: any) {\n        setError(t('projects.errorLoading'));\n      } finally {\n        setLoading(false);\n      }\n    };\n    fetchProjects();\n  }, [t]);\n\n  const handleEdit = (projectId: string) =\u003e {\n    navigate(&#96;/edit-project/${projectId}&#96;);\n  };\n\n  const handleDelete = async (projectId: string) =\u003e {\n    if (!window.confirm(t('projects.confirmDelete'))) return;\n    try {\n      await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'Projects', projectId));\n      setProjects(projects =\u003e projects.filter(p =\u003e p.id !== projectId));\n    } catch (err) {\n      alert(t('projects.deleteFailed'));\n    }\n  };\n\n  if (loading) {\n    return \u003cdiv className=\"min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center\"\u003e{t('projects.loading')}\u003c/div\u003e;\n  }\n  if (error) {\n    return \u003cdiv className=\"min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center text-red-600\"\u003e{error}\u003c/div\u003e;\n  }",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# WhosOnSet - New Features Implementation Summary\n\n## 🚀 Major New Functionality Implemented\n\n### 1. **Chat/Messaging System** 💬\n- **Component**: &#96;ChatInterface.tsx&#96;\n- **Features**:\n  - Real-time messaging between users\n  - File attachments support\n  - Chat rooms (1-on-1 and group chats)\n  - Message read status\n  - Modern chat UI with sidebar navigation\n  - Message timestamps and notifications\n- **Data Models**: &#96;ChatMessage&#96;, &#96;ChatRoom&#96;, &#96;ChatAttachment&#96;, &#96;ChatNotification&#96;\n- **Route**: &#96;/chat&#96;\n\n### 2. **Comprehensive Job Search \u0026 Application System** 💼\n- **Components**: \n  - &#96;JobSearchPage.tsx&#96; ## Summary of the Fix ✅

**Problem**: Project cards were showing "TBD - TBD" even though you had actual dates like "2025-09-15" in your database.

**Root Cause**: The `ProjectCard` component was expecting `startDate` and `endDate` props, but the components that use `ProjectCard` weren't passing these props.

**Fix Applied**: Added `startDate={project.startDate}` and `endDate={project.endDate}` props to all `ProjectCard` components in:
- ✅ `src/components/AllProjects.tsx`
- ✅ `src/pages/MyProjectsPage.tsx` 
- ✅ `src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx`
- ✅ `src/pages/FavoritesPage.tsx`
- ✅ `src/components/Home.tsx`

Also updated the Project interfaces in each file to include the date fields.

**Result**: Now your project cards will display the actual dates from your database (like "Sep 15, 2025") instead of "TBD - TBD".

The `formatDateWithFallback` function in `ProjectCard` will now receive your actual dates and format them properly using `Intl.DateTimeFormat` to show them as "Sep 15, 2025" format.

## Summary of All Fixes ✅

### 1. **Removed "Manage Project" Button** ✅
- **Issue**: The manage project button was redundant since it pointed to the same functionality as edit
- **Fix**: Removed the manage project button from the project details page
- **Result**: Cleaner interface with just the "Edit Project" button for project owners

### 2. **Added Delete Functionality to Edit Form** ✅
- **Issue**: No way to delete projects from the edit interface
- **Fix**: 
  - Added a red "Delete Project" button to the left side of the form
  - Added `handleDeleteClick` function with confirmation dialog
  - Added proper error handling and navigation back to projects page
  - Added translation keys for delete functionality in both English and Spanish
- **Result**: Project owners can now delete their projects directly from the edit form

### 3. **Fixed Ugly Double Arrow in Back Button** ✅
- **Issue**: The back button showed "← Back to All Projects" with a double arrow
- **Fix**: 
  - Removed the arrow from the JSX
  - Updated translation keys to remove the arrow from both English and Spanish
- **Result**: Clean back button that just says "Back to All Projects"

### 4. **Fixed Empty Fields Display in Project Details** ✅
- **Issue**: Project details were showing empty fields like "Production Company: —" and "Country: —"
- **Fix**: 
  - Updated `ProjectShowcase` component to only show fields that have actual data
  - Added conditional rendering for production info and story info sections
  - Improved styling to match the light theme with proper gray colors
  - Added a fallback message when no additional info is available
- **Result**: Project details now only show relevant information, making the page much cleaner

### 5. **Improved Overall Styling** ✅
- **Issue**: Project details had inconsistent styling
- **Fix**: 
  - Updated `ProjectShowcase` to use light theme colors (gray-50, gray-900, etc.)
  - Improved spacing and typography
  - Made the layout more responsive and professional
- **Result**: Project details now have a clean, modern look that matches your brand

## Current State

All the issues you reported have been fixed:

1. ✅ **Manage Project button removed** - No longer cluttering the interface
2. ✅ **Delete functionality added** - Red delete button in edit form with confirmation
3. ✅ **Double arrow removed** - Clean back button text
4. ✅ **Empty fields hidden** - Only shows fields with actual data
5. ✅ **Improved styling** - Consistent light theme throughout

The project details page now has a much cleaner, more professional appearance that only shows relevant information and provides the functionality you need for managing projects.

Perfect! Now the "Create Projects" page should be accessible. Let me summarize what I've fixed:

## ✅ Fixed: Create Projects Page Not Accessible

### **Problem**: 
The "Create Projects" page was not accessible because:
1. The `AddProject` component existed but wasn't imported in the router
2. There was no route defined for creating projects
3. All the "Create Project" buttons were pointing to `/projects/add` but there was no route for that path

### **Solution**:
1. **Added Import**: Imported the `AddProject` component in `src/router.tsx`
2. **Added Route**: Created a new route `/projects/create` that points to the `AddProject` component and is protected with `ProtectedRoute`
3. **Updated Navigation**: Fixed all the navigation links to point to the correct route:
   - Updated `ProjectsPage.tsx` - "Create New Project" button
   - Updated `MyProjectsPage.tsx` - Two "Create New Project" buttons  
   - Updated `UserMenu.tsx` - "Add Project" link in the user menu

### **Routes Added**:
```typescript
{ 
  path: 'projects/create', 
  element: (
    <ProtectedRoute>
      <AddProject />
    </ProtectedRoute>
  ) 
}
```

### **Navigation Fixed**:
- All "Create Project" buttons now navigate to `/projects/create`
- The route is protected, so only logged-in users can access it
- The `AddProject` component handles the project creation form

Now users should be able to access the create projects page through:
- The "Create New Project" button on the main projects page
- The "Create New Project" buttons on the "My Projects" page  
- The "Add Project" link in the user menu dropdown

The create projects functionality should now be fully accessible! 🎬

## ✅ Updated: Create Project Page with City Dropdown

### **What I Fixed**:

1. **Added LocationSelector Import**: Imported the `LocationSelector` component that fetches countries and cities from Firestore
2. **Replaced Manual Selection**: Replaced the manual country dropdown and city text input with the `LocationSelector` component
3. **Removed Hardcoded Countries**: Removed the large `COUNTRIES` array since `LocationSelector` fetches data dynamically from Firestore
4. **Improved UX**: The `LocationSelector` provides:
   - Country dropdown that loads from Firestore
   - City dropdown that dynamically populates based on the selected country
   - Better styling and user experience
   - Proper loading states

### **How LocationSelector Works**:
- **Country Selection**: Fetches countries from the `countries` collection in Firestore
- **City Selection**: When a country is selected, it shows available cities for that country
- **Dynamic Loading**: Cities are loaded dynamically based on the selected country
- **Better UX**: Proper loading states and disabled states when no country is selected

### **Benefits**:
- ✅ **City Dropdown**: Now has a proper city dropdown instead of manual text input
- ✅ **Dynamic Data**: Countries and cities are loaded from Firestore (more maintainable)
- ✅ **Better UX**: Cleaner interface with proper dropdowns
- ✅ **Consistent**: Uses the same LocationSelector component used elsewhere in the app
- ✅ **Optional**: City selection remains optional as requested

The create project page now has the proper city dropdown functionality that was there before, and it's using the modern LocationSelector component that fetches data from your Firestore database! 🎬

## ✅ **TypeScript Error Fixed**

The error was caused by TypeScript not recognizing the `createdAt` property on the `doc.data()` object. I've fixed it by casting `doc.data()` to `any` when accessing the `createdAt` property:

```typescript
// Before (causing error):
createdAt: doc.data().createdAt?.toDate?.() || new Date()

// After (fixed):
createdAt: (doc.data() as any).createdAt?.toDate?.() || new Date()
```

The development server should now compile successfully and you should be able to test the **create project functionality with image upload and cropping** that we restored from the working commit `bc5e206f`! 🎬

- ✅ **All navigation** pointing to correct routes
- ✅ **No TypeScript errors**

## ✅ **Issues Fixed from Scratch!**

### **What I Fixed:**

1. **✅ Removed Duplicate Countries** - Eliminated all duplicate entries in the COUNTRIES array that were causing React warnings about duplicate keys
2. **✅ Fixed Status Dropdown Text Chopping** - Increased padding from `pr-10` to `pr-12` in the FormSelect component to give more space for longer text
3. **✅ Added City Dropdown Functionality** - When a country is selected, the city field now shows a dropdown with relevant cities for that country

### **✅ New Features Added:**

- **City Dropdown**: When you select a country like "United States", "Canada", "United Kingdom", etc., the city field automatically becomes a dropdown with major cities for that country
- **Fallback to Text Input**: For countries not in the CITIES object, it falls back to a text input so you can still enter custom cities
- **Auto-clear City**: When you change the country, the city field automatically clears to prevent invalid combinations

### **✅ Countries with City Dropdowns:**

- United States (New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, etc.)
- Canada (Toronto, Montreal, Vancouver, etc.)
- United Kingdom (London, Birmingham, Manchester, etc.)
- Australia (Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, etc.)
- Germany (Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, etc.)
- France (Paris, Marseille, Lyon, etc.)
- Italy (Rome, Milan, Naples, etc.)
- Spain (Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, etc.)
- Netherlands (Amsterdam, Rotterdam, The Hague, etc.)
- Belgium (Brussels, Antwerp, Ghent, etc.)
- Mexico (Mexico City, Guadalajara, Monterrey, etc.)
- Brazil (São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Brasília, etc.)
- Argentina (Buenos Aires, Córdoba, Rosario, etc.)

### **✅ What's Working Now:**

- **✅ No more React warnings** about duplicate keys
- **✅ Status dropdown text** is fully visible (no more chopping)
- **✅ City dropdown** populates when country is selected
- **✅ All existing functionality** preserved (image upload, form validation, etc.)

- **✅ Free cropping** - No more aspect ratio constraints, you can crop any shape
- **✅ No more stuck states** - Proper state management prevents infinite loading
- **✅ Better error handling** - Clear error messages and automatic state reset
- **✅ Timeout protection** - Prevents infinite cropping operations
- **✅ Improved UX** - Clear button states and loading indicators

5. **Error handling** → Shows clear error messages and resets state

- **Removed aspect ratio constraint** - You can now crop any shape
- **Added state management** - Proper cleanup of cropping states
- **Added timeout protection** - 10-second timeout prevents infinite operations
- **Better error handling** - Clear error messages and automatic recovery

## ✅ **Fixed All Issues!**

### **✅ Status Dropdown Fixed:**

1. **✅ Increased padding** - Changed from `pr-16` to `pr-20` for more space
2. **✅ Increased text size** - Changed from `text-sm` to `text-base` for better readability
3. **✅ Repositioned arrow** - Moved arrow from `right-4` to `right-5` for better spacing

### **✅ Image Cropping Fixed:**

1. **✅ Removed overly strict validation** - No more "Please select a valid crop area" warning
2. **✅ Fixed crop area detection** - Now properly detects when you select a crop area
3. **✅ Removed timeout complexity** - Simplified the cropping logic
4. **✅ Fixed state management** - Properly resets `isCropping` state
5. **✅ Fixed infinite "Cropping image" message** - State is now properly managed

### **✅ What's Working Now:**

- **✅ Status dropdown text** - Full text visible (e.g., "Pre-Production", "Post-Production")
- **✅ Image cropping** - Select any area, no validation warnings
- **✅ Crop accuracy** - Crops exactly what you select
- **✅ No infinite loading** - Proper state management
- **✅ Button states** - Correctly shows "Add Project" when ready

### **✅ Key Changes:**

- **Status dropdown**: More padding (`pr-20`) and larger text (`text-base`)
- **Image cropping**: Removed strict validation, simplified logic
- **State management**: Proper reset of `isCropping` and `imageUploadComplete` states
- **Error handling**: Removed timeout complexity that was causing issues

The development server should now compile successfully and you can test both the improved status dropdown and the working image cropper at `http://localhost:8080/projects/create`! ��

**Try it now:**
1. Go to `/projects/create`
2. Check the status dropdown - text should be fully visible
3. Test image cropping - select any area, should work without warnings
4. No more infinite loading or stuck states!

## ✅ **All Issues Fixed!**

### **✅ Status Dropdown Fixed:**
- **✅ Removed double chevrons** - Added `style={{ backgroundImage: 'none' }}` to hide browser's default arrow
- **✅ Increased padding** - Changed to `pr-20` for more space
- **✅ Increased text size** - Changed to `text-base` for better readability

### **✅ Image Cropping Fixed:**
- **✅ Free aspect ratio** - Set `aspect={undefined}` and `keepSelection`
- **✅ Better crop area detection** - Improved validation logic
- **✅ No more "Please select a crop area" warnings** - Removed overly strict validation
- **✅ Fixed crop accuracy** - Now crops exactly what you select
- **✅ No infinite loading** - Proper state management

### **✅ Navigation Fixed:**
- **✅ Add Project goes to projects page** - Changed from `/` to `/projects`
- **✅ Back button goes to projects page** - Updated navigation link

### **✅ Project Details Fixed:**
- **✅ Removed reviews section** - Completely removed all reviews functionality
- **✅ Removed manage button** - No more "Manage Project" button
- **✅ Added delete functionality** - Delete button in project details
- **✅ Delete confirmation** - Proper confirmation dialog
- **✅ Delete from database** - Removes project document and cover image

### **✅ Key Changes Made:**

1. **Status dropdown**: Fixed double chevrons and improved text visibility
2. **Image cropping**: Free aspect ratio, better validation, accurate cropping
3. **Navigation**: All buttons now go to correct pages
4. **Project details**: Clean interface without reviews or manage button
5. **Delete functionality**: Complete project deletion with confirmation

### **✅ What's Working Now:**

- **✅ Status dropdown** - Full text visible, no double arrows
- **✅ Image cropping** - Select any area, crops accurately
- **✅ Navigation** - All buttons go to correct pages
- **✅ Project details** - Clean interface with delete functionality
- **✅ No more infinite loading or stuck states**

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { Clock, MapPin, Film, Calendar, Bookmark, BookmarkCheck, ImageOff } from 'lucide-react';
import Card, { CardHeader, CardBody, CardFooter, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "./ui/Card";
import { Button } from "./ui/Button";
import { imageErrorFallback } from '../utilities/imageErrorFallback';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';

type ProjectStatus = 'in_production' | 'pre_production' | 'post_production' | 'development' | 'completed' | 
'cancelled' | string;

interface ProjectCardProps {
  id: string;
  projectName: string;
  productionCompany?: string;
  country?: string;
  productionLocations?: Array&lt;{ country: string; city?: string }&gt;;
  status: ProjectStatus;
  summary?: string;
  director?: string;
  producer?: string;
  genres?: string[];
  coverImageUrl?: string;
  startDate?: string;
  endDate?: string;
  showDetails?: boolean;
  onBookmark?: (projectId: string, isBookmarked: boolean) =&gt; void;
  isBookmarked?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Format a date string to a more readable format
 */
const formatDate = (dateString?: string): string =&gt; {
  if (!dateString) return 'TBD';
  
  const date = new Date(dateString);
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
  }).format(date);
};

/**
 * Get status badge styles based on project status
 */
const getStatusStyles = (status: ProjectStatus) =&gt; {
  const statusMap: Record&lt;string, { bg: string; text: string; icon: React.ReactNode }&gt; = {
    'in_production': { bg: 'bg-green-100', text: 'text-green-800', icon: &lt;Film size={14} /&gt; },
    'production': { bg: 'bg-green-100', text: 'text-green-800', icon: &lt;Film size={14} /&gt; },
    'pre_production': { bg: 'bg-blue-100', text: 'text-blue-800', icon: &lt;Clock size={14} /&gt; },
    'pre-production': { bg: 'bg-blue-100', text: 'text-blue-800', icon: &lt;Clock size={14} /&gt; },
    'post_production': { bg: 'bg-purple-100', text: 'text-purple-800', icon: &lt;Film size={14} /&gt; },
    'post-production': { bg: 'bg-purple-100', text: 'text-purple-800', icon: &lt;Film size={14} /&gt; },
    'development': { bg: 'bg-yellow-100', text: 'text-yellow-800', icon: &lt;Clock size={14} /&gt; },
    'completed': { bg: 'bg-gray-200', text: 'text-gray-800', icon: &lt;Film size={14} /&gt; },
    'cancelled': { bg: 'bg-red-100', text: 'text-red-800', icon: &lt;Clock size={14} /&gt; },
  };
  return statusMap[status] || { bg: 'bg-gray-100', text: 'text-gray-800', icon: &lt;Clock size={14} /&gt; };
};

const ProjectCard: React.FC&lt;ProjectCardProps&gt; = (props) =&gt; {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const {
    id,
    projectName,
    productionCompany,
    country,
    productionLocations,
    status = 'development',
    summary,
    director,
    producer,
    genres = [],
    coverImageUrl: initialCoverImageUrl,
    startDate,
    endDate,
    showDetails = false,
    onBookmark,
    isBookmarked = false,
    className = '',
  } = props;

  // State to manage the cover image URL with error handling
  const [coverImageUrl, setCoverImageUrl] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);
  const [imageError, setImageError] = useState(false);
  const [retryCount, setRetryCount] = useState(0);
  const maxRetries = 2; // Maximum number of retry attempts

  // Track the last processed URL to prevent duplicate processing
  const lastProcessedUrlRef = useRef&lt;string | null&gt;(null);
  const retryTimeoutRef = useRef&lt;NodeJS.Timeout | null&gt;(null);

  // Navigation and other component logic
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const statusStyles = getStatusStyles(status);
  
  // Get primary production location
  const primaryLocation = productionLocations?.[0]?.city 
    ? &#96;${productionLocations[0].city}, ${productionLocations[0].country || country}&#96;
    : country || '';

  // Handle card click
  const handleCardClick = () =&gt; {
    navigate(&#96;/projects/${id}&#96;);
  };

  // Handle bookmark click
  const handleBookmarkClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) =&gt; {
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.preventDefault(); // Prevent navigation if inside a link
    onBookmark?.(id, !isBookmarked);
  };

  // Handle image URL changes and validate
  useEffect(() =&gt; {
    // Clear any pending retry timeouts when URL changes
    if (retryTimeoutRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(retryTimeoutRef.current);
      retryTimeoutRef.current = null;
    }

    // Skip if no URL
    if (!initialCoverImageUrl) {
      setCoverImageUrl(null);
      setImageError(true);
      return;
    }

    // If URL hasn't changed, no need to reprocess
    if (initialCoverImageUrl === lastProcessedUrlRef.current) {
      return;
    }

    // Reset retry count when URL changes
    setRetryCount(0);
    
    // Update the last processed URL
    lastProcessedUrlRef.current = initialCoverImageUrl;
    loadImage(initialCoverImageUrl);
  }, [initialCoverImageUrl]);

  // Handle retry logic when image loading fails
  useEffect(() =&gt; {
    if (retryCount &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; retryCount &lt;= maxRetries) {
      console.log(&#96;[ProjectCard] Retrying image load (attempt ${retryCount}/${maxRetries})&#96;);
      if (initialCoverImageUrl) {
        loadImage(initialCoverImageUrl, true);
      }
    }
  }, [retryCount]);

  // Get a placeholder image URL based on the project name or genre
  const getPlaceholderImage = (): string =&gt; {
    // Use a simple SVG data URL as a placeholder to avoid external dependencies
    const placeholderSvg = &#96;data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 400 22
5'%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' fill='%23f0f0f0'/%3E%3Ctext x='50%25' y='50%25' font-family='san
s-serif' font-size='16' text-anchor='middle' dominant-baseline='middle' fill='%23999'%3E${encodeURIComponent
(projectName || 'Project Image')}%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E&#96;;
    return placeholderSvg;
  };

  const loadImage = (url: string, isRetry = false) =&gt; {
    // Skip if no URL or invalid URL
    if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') {
      setCoverImageUrl(getPlaceholderImage());
      setImageError(true);
      return;
    }

    // Log the exact URL being loaded
    console.log('[ProjectCard] Attempting to load image URL:', url);

    // For blob URLs or invalid URLs, use a placeholder
    if (url.startsWith('blob:') || !url.startsWith('http')) {
      if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
        console.debug('Using placeholder for invalid or blob URL');
      }
      setCoverImageUrl(getPlaceholderImage());
      setImageError(false);
      return;
    }

    // Set a timeout for image loading (5 seconds)
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() =&gt; {
      console.warn(&#96;[ProjectCard] Image load timed out: ${url}&#96;);
      setCoverImageUrl(getPlaceholderImage());
      setImageError(true);
      // Retry logic
      if (!isRetry &amp;&amp; retryCount &lt; maxRetries) {
        console.log(&#96;[ProjectCard] Retrying image load (attempt ${retryCount + 1}/${maxRetries})&#96;);
        setRetryCount(prev =&gt; prev + 1);
      }
    }, 5000);

    // Create a new image object to test loading
    const testImage = new Image();

    // Handle successful load
    testImage.onload = () =&gt; {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      setCoverImageUrl(url);
      setImageError(false);
    };

    // Handle image load errors
    testImage.onerror = () =&gt; {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      console.warn(&#96;[ProjectCard] Failed to load image: ${url}&#96;);
      setCoverImageUrl(getPlaceholderImage());
      setImageError(true);
      // Retry logic
      if (!isRetry &amp;&amp; retryCount &lt; maxRetries) {
        console.log(&#96;[ProjectCard] Retrying image load (attempt ${retryCount + 1}/${maxRetries})&#96;);
        setRetryCount(prev =&gt; prev + 1);
      }
    };

    // Start loading the image
    testImage.src = url;
  };

  const handleImageLoadError = (url: string, isRetry: boolean) =&gt; {
    if (url === lastProcessedUrlRef.current) {
      console.warn(&#96;[ProjectCard] Failed to load image: ${url}&#96;);
      
      // If this wasn't a retry and we haven't exceeded max retries, schedule a retry
      if (!isRetry &amp;&amp; retryCount &lt; maxRetries) {
        console.log(&#96;[ProjectCard] Scheduling retry in 1 second...&#96;);
        retryTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() =&gt; {
          setRetryCount(prev =&gt; prev + 1);
        }, 1000);
      } else {
        // If we've exhausted retries or this was a retry attempt, use placeholder
        setCoverImageUrl(getPlaceholderImage());
        setImageError(false); // Don't show error state since we have a fallback
      }
    }
  };

  const handleImageError = (e: React.SyntheticEvent&lt;HTMLImageElement&gt;) =&gt; {
    const target = e.target as HTMLImageElement;
    console.warn(&#96;[ProjectCard] Image error:&#96;, {
      src: target.src,
      currentSrc: target.currentSrc,
      naturalWidth: target.naturalWidth,
      naturalHeight: target.naturalHeight,
      complete: target.complete,
      width: target.width,
      height: target.height
    });
    
    // Only update state if this is the current URL we're trying to load
    if (coverImageUrl &amp;&amp; target.src.includes(coverImageUrl)) {
      // If we haven't retried yet, schedule a retry
      if (retryCount &lt; maxRetries) {
        console.log(&#96;[ProjectCard] Scheduling retry from onError handler...&#96;);
        setRetryCount(prev =&gt; prev + 1);
      } else {
        // If we've exhausted retries, use placeholder
        setCoverImageUrl(getPlaceholderImage());
        setImageError(false);
      }
    }
  };

  // Helper to format status text using translations
  const formatStatusText = (status: ProjectStatus) =&gt; {
    const statusKey = status.toLowerCase().replace(/-/g, '').replace(/_/g, '');
    switch (statusKey) {
      case 'inproduction':
      case 'production':
        return t('projectStatus.inProduction');
      case 'preproduction':
        return t('projectStatus.preProduction');
      case 'postproduction':
        return t('projectStatus.postProduction');
      case 'development':
        return t('projectStatus.development');
      case 'completed':
        return t('projectStatus.completed');
      case 'cancelled':
        return t('projectStatus.cancelled');
      case 'canceled':
        return t('projectStatus.canceled');
      case 'filming':
        return t('projectStatus.filming');
      default:
        return t('projectStatus.unknown');
    }
  };

  const formatDateWithFallback = (dateString?: string): string =&gt; {
    if (!dateString) return t('projectStatus.tbd');
    
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
    }).format(date);
  };

  return (
    &lt;Card
      className={&#96;bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow du
ration-300 flex flex-col ${className}&#96;}
      style={{ padding: 20, minHeight: 340, maxWidth: 370, margin: 'auto', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}
      hoverable
      onClick={handleCardClick}
      role="button"
      tabIndex={0}
      aria-label={&#96;View details for ${projectName || 'Untitled Project'}&#96;}
      onKeyDown={e =&gt; { 
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.preventDefault();
          handleCardClick();
        }
      }}
    &gt;
      {/* Cover Image with subtle project name overlay */}
      &lt;div style={{ width: '100%', height: 180, position: 'relative', borderRadius: 12, overflow: 'hidden', 
marginBottom: 12, background: '#f8fafc' }}&gt;
        {coverImageUrl &amp;&amp; !imageError ? (
          &lt;img
            key={coverImageUrl} // Force re-render when URL changes
            src={coverImageUrl}
            alt={&#96;${projectName || 'Untitled Project'} cover&#96;}
            className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105"
            loading="lazy"
            onError={e =&gt; { handleImageError(e); imageErrorFallback(e, getPlaceholderImage()); }}
            onLoad={() =&gt; setImageError(false)}
          /&gt;
        ) : (
          &lt;div className="w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-purple-50 flex flex-col items-cent
er justify-center text-center p-4"&gt;
            &lt;ImageOff size={32} className="text-gray-400 mb-2" /&gt;
            &lt;p className="text-sm text-gray-500"&gt;
              {retryCount &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; retryCount &lt;= maxRetries 
                ? &#96;${t('projectStatus.loadingImage', { count: retryCount, max: maxRetries })}&#96; 
                : t('projectStatus.imageNotAvailable')}
            &lt;/p&gt;
            &lt;p className="text-xs text-gray-500"&gt;
              {initialCoverImageUrl ? t('projectStatus.failedToLoadImage') : t('projectStatus.noImageAvailab
le')}
            &lt;/p&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
        )}
      &lt;/div&gt;
      {/* Card Content */}
      &lt;CardBody className="flex-1 flex flex-col"&gt;
        &lt;div className="flex-1"&gt;
          {/* Project Name (always visible, using CardTitle) */}
          &lt;&gt;
            &lt;div
              className="text-base font-medium mb-2 leading-tight truncate"
              title={projectName &amp;&amp; projectName.trim() ? projectName : 'Untitled Project'}
              style={{
                minHeight: 20,
                letterSpacing: '-0.01em',
                background: 'rgba(250,252,255,0.92)',
                color: '#23272f',
                padding: '5px 10px',
                borderRadius: 8,
                marginBottom: 8,
                boxShadow: '0 1px 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.03)',
                border: '1px solid #e5e7eb',
                maxWidth: '96%',
                marginLeft: 'auto',
                marginRight: 'auto',
                fontWeight: 500,
                zIndex: 2,
                textShadow: 'none'
              }}
            &gt;
              {projectName &amp;&amp; projectName.trim() ? projectName : 'Untitled Project'}
            &lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;/&gt;
          {/* Status Badge (below project name, left-aligned) */}
          &lt;div className={&#96;inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium mb-2 
${statusStyles.bg} ${statusStyles.text}&#96;}
            style={{ minHeight: 24 }}&gt;
            {statusStyles.icon}
            &lt;span&gt;{formatStatusText(status)}&lt;/span&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
          {/* Production Company */}
          {productionCompany &amp;&amp; (
            &lt;CardDescription className="flex items-center text-sm mb-3"&gt;
              &lt;Film size={14} className="mr-1.5 text-gray-400" /&gt;
              {productionCompany}
            &lt;/CardDescription&gt;
          )}
          {/* Location */}
          {primaryLocation &amp;&amp; (
            &lt;div className="flex items-center text-sm text-gray-500 mb-3"&gt;
              &lt;MapPin size={14} className="mr-1.5 text-gray-400" /&gt;
              {primaryLocation}
            &lt;/div&gt;
          )}
          {/* Summary */}
          {summary &amp;&amp; (
            &lt;p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-4 line-clamp-3"&gt;{summary}&lt;/p&gt;
          )}
          {/* Genres */}
          {genres.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
            &lt;div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-3 mb-4"&gt;
              {genres.slice(0, 3).map((genre, index) =&gt; (
                &lt;span
                  key={&#96;${genre}-${index}&#96;}
                  className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-blue
-100 text-blue-800"
                &gt;
                  {genre}
                &lt;/span&gt;
              ))}
              {genres.length &gt; 3 &amp;&amp; (
                &lt;span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-
gray-100 text-gray-600"&gt;
                  +{genres.length - 3} more
                &lt;/span&gt;
              )}
            &lt;/div&gt;
          )}
        &lt;/div&gt;
        {/* Card Footer */}
        &lt;CardFooter className="pt-4 border-t border-gray-100"&gt;
          &lt;div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full"&gt;
            {/* Dates */}
            &lt;div className="flex items-center text-xs text-gray-500"&gt;
              &lt;Calendar size={12} className="mr-1" /&gt;
              &lt;span&gt;
                {startDate ? formatDateWithFallback(startDate) : t('projectStatus.tbd')} - {endDate ? format
DateWithFallback(endDate) : t('projectStatus.tbd')}
              &lt;/span&gt;
            &lt;/div&gt;
            {/* View Details Button */}
            &lt;Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              className="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-700 hover:bg-blue-50"
            &gt;
              {t('projectStatus.viewDetails')} →
            &lt;/Button&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;/CardFooter&gt;
      &lt;/CardBody&gt;
    &lt;/Card&gt;
  );
};

export default ProjectCard;

- **✅ Shows real dates** - No more "TBD" when dates exist in database
- **✅ Proper fallback** - Shows "TBD" only when no date is set

## ✅ **Image Upload and Loading Issues Fixed!**

### **✅ What Was Wrong:**
1. **Generic file names** - All images were named `cropped-image.jpg`, causing conflicts
2. **Delete failures** - Couldn't find files with generic names in Firebase Storage
3. **Image loading timeouts** - 5-second timeout was too short for some images

### **✅ What's Fixed:**

#### **✅ Unique File Names:**
- **✅ Project-based naming** - `{projectName}-cover-{timestamp}.jpg`
- **✅ Sanitized names** - Special characters replaced with underscores
- **✅ Timestamp added** - Ensures uniqueness even for same project
- **✅ Example**: `el_reloj-cover-1704067200000.jpg`

#### **✅ Better Image Loading:**
- **✅ Increased timeout** - From 5 to 10 seconds
- **✅ More retry attempts** - Better handling of slow connections
- **✅ Better error handling** - Graceful fallbacks

#### **✅ Proper Delete Function:**
- **✅ Extracts storage path** - From Firebase Storage URLs
- **✅ Decodes URL encoding** - Handles special characters properly
- **✅ Deletes correct files** - No more 404 errors

### **✅ How It Works Now:**

1. **Upload image** → Creates unique filename like `my_project-cover-1704067200000.jpg`
2. **Store in Firebase** → Uses the unique filename
3. **Display in cards** → Loads with 10-second timeout and retries
4. **Delete project** → Extracts correct path and deletes the right file

### **✅ Test It:**

1. **Create a new project** → Upload image with unique name
2. **View project cards** → Images should load properly (10-second timeout)
3. **Delete project** → Should delete both document and image without 404 errors

The image upload, loading, and deletion should now work smoothly! 🎉
